title: Correct wide miniature isometric camera presentation
acceptance: the driving camera is visually tuned toward a Smashy Road-like elevated miniature/isometric presentation: substantially wider than the T009 34 m vertical view, with a more top-down readable angle and a fixed world orientation rather than a close chase-camera feel
at ordinary city driving speeds the viewport exposes multiple upcoming road choices/intersections far enough ahead to plan a turn instead of discovering it at the edge of the screen

camera yaw/pitch/framing are tuned against the real Manhattan fixture so the street grid reads as intentional isometric geometry rather than an awkward asymmetric projection; vehicle yaw/roll/pitch still do not rotate the world camera
speed-based look-ahead/zoom remain bounded and smooth, floating-origin rebases remain visually continuous, and the player car stays readable without occupying an excessive share of the viewport
a browser visual verification captures representative stationary, straight-driving, and turning frames and records owner-reference comparison notes before integration
